events.title: Organ recital with Hanne Kuhlmann
events.description: Hanne Kuhlmann (Copenhagen Cathedral), organ. Works by Schmidt, Bach, Preston, Scheidemann, Krebs and Messiaen. Dear friends of organ music, Welcome to Oslo Cathedral and this year's summer concert series! Over the course of 15 Saturdays from July to October, we invite you to festive and diverse concerts featuring organists from both Norway and abroad. Each concert has its own distinct character, reflecting the musical background and tradition of the guest performer. During the summer months, when everyday life tends to slow down and time feels more spacious, we wish to present a rich and varied musical program on our cathedral organ, built in 1998 by the Norwegian organ builder Ryde & Berg. We are committed to making organ music accessible to as many people as possible. Please feel free to take the program with you, share it with friends and family, and invite someone along to a concert. Admission is always free for children and students. We look forward to seeing you at Oslo Cathedral and wish you a joyful and inspiring summer! Marcus André Berg and Tjark Pinne Organists of Oslo Cathedral. Accessibility: Oslo Cathedral has dedicated wheelchair spaces in the south transept. Companions enter free of charge upon presenting a companion certificate. Oslo Cathedral has a ramp and an elevator for step-free access. Please arrive at the main entrance, and our staff will guide you to the wheelchair entrance. A wheelchair-accessible restroom is available by the main entrance. For questions; please call Oslo Cathedral, phone: +47 23629010

events.description: We're celebrating Knut's 80 young and wonderful years on the very day, 3rd of October 2026, from 18:00--24:00. Join us for an evening filled with great food and music (from several of Knut's musical friends), wonderful people, and a memorable celebration of our one and only Knut! events.title: OLIVER TWIST - Koffers produksjoner
events.description: OLIVER TWIST -- EN MUSIKAL SOM TREFFER HJERTET Den populære familiemusikalen OLIVER TWIST! har begeistret publikum verden over -- nå er det CHATEAU NEUF sin tur! KUN 6 FORESTILLINGER! Oliver Twist er en amatør produksjon basert på Charles Dickens' udødelige fortelling byr musikalen på sterke følelser, gripende historier og uforglemmelige musikalske numre. Denne versjonen er en hyllest til de glemte barna -- de som lider i stillhet, uten noen som ser dem eller beskytter dem. OLIVER TWIST minner oss om hvor sårbar barndommen er, og hvor lett vi voksne kan overse tegn på ensomhet, mobbing og fortvilelse. Gjennom Oliver møter vi barnet i oss selv -- og i andre -- de som ble tvunget til å vokse opp altfor fort i 1800-tallets London. events.title: Konradsen - 10 years!
events.description: 10TH ANNIVERSARY CONCERT: KONRADSEN!! The duo Konradsen is celebrating 10 years and invites you to a very special anniversary concert at Kulturkirken Jakob -- the exact venue where they held their very first release concert! On this evening, they are stripping things back and sharing the stage with good friends made along the way. Since 2019, Jenny Marie Sabel and Eirik Vildgren have carved out a unique place in the Norwegian indie scene with their distinctive, intricate, and critically acclaimed sound. This concert also marks the release of their third album, Hunt, Gather -- a personal and introspective record about the life spent chasing goals for years, and the longing for something more. The release was celebrated with a truly unique, sold-out concert experience at MUNCH in Oslo on April 10th. Now, they are coming to Kulturkirken Jakob! Konradsen's music shifts between the romantic, playful, and deeply emotional, blending subtle glimpses of reality---like audio clips from old family videos and chats with friends---with synths, piano, and a nuanced musical landscape. The result is a complex soundscape that feels both weightless and intimate all at once. The album Hunt, Gather was produced by Hans Olav Settem and Marit Othilie Thorvik (Beharie, Ea Othilde, Jouska) in collaboration with the duo themselves. A major part of the music was also co-written with Erlend Vesteraas and Ivar Myrset Asheim, both of whom are key contributors to the project. Come celebrate 10 years of Konradsen and experience a concert that moves seamlessly between the deeply intimate and the grand!

events.title: SPARK 2026 – En kveld for deg som vil mer
events.description: Velkommen til SPARK 2026 i Storsalen på Chateau Neuf i Oslo. Aldersgrense: 18 Ingen vergeordning Dette er ikke en konferanse. Dette er en inspirasjonskveld og et sceneshow for deg som jobber med salg, ledelse eller ønsker å ta neste steg i livet. Gjennom en kveld fylt med energi, historier og ekte erfaring fra scenen, tar Charles Joachimsen deg med på en reise gjennom salg, mindset og hva som faktisk kreves for å lykkes. Charles har over 20 års erfaring innen salg og coaching, og har jobbet med tusenvis av selgere og ledere i Norge. Denne kvelden samler han det beste i én opplevelse -- med mål om å gi deg et tydelig løft, ny motivasjon og et konkret driv til å nå dine mål. Dette er en kveld for alle bransjer. For deg som vil utvikle deg. For deg som vil mer. Dørene åpner kl. 18:30 Showstart kl. 19:00 Begrenset antall plasser. Billettinformasjon: Early Bird Et begrenset antall billetter til redusert pris for de som er tidlig ute. Gir tilgang til hele arrangementet i ordinære sitteplasser. Ordinær billett Standardbillett med tilgang til hele arrangementet. Gir deg en kveld med inspirasjon, energi og påfyll fra scenen. VIP -- Inner Circle For deg som ønsker en utvidet og mer eksklusiv opplevelse. VIP-billetten inkluderer: -- De beste plassene i salen -- Meet & greet med Charles Joachimsen -- Invitasjon til middag på eget sted (middag betales selv) -- 2 eksklusive coaching sessions med Charles Joachimsen Charles Joachimsen Rullestol/ledsager. Dedikerte plasser for rullestol og ledsager til rullestolbrukere bak på felt A/F. Ledsager betaler ordinær pris. For Gruppebestilling fyll ut dette skjemaet: Gruppesalg
